name: Pond Morning
description: A misty park pond at sunrise: drifting mist, a hen with three ducklings and a drake swimming across, fish rings on the water and a swaying willow.

steps.script: const n = project.elements.length; for (const i of [n-3,n-2,n-1]) project.elements[i].name += ' Main'; return 1
const n = project.elements.length; for (const i of [n-3,n-2,n-1]) project.elements[i].name += ' Aod'; return 1

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gDucks = 'Ducks'; project.groups.gMist = 'Mist and rings'; let n = 0; for (const e of project.elements) { if (['Hen','Drake'].includes(e.name) || /^Duckling/.test(e.name)) { e.group = 'gDucks'; n++ } if (/^(Mist|Fish ring)/.test(e.name)) { e.group = 'gMist'; n++ } } return n

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gDate = 'Date'; let n = 0; for (const e of project.elements) { if (e.name === 'Weekday' || e.name === 'Day' || e.name === 'Month') { e.group = 'gDate'; n++ } } for (const k of Object.keys(project.groups)) if (project.groups[k] === 'Clock 2') project.groups[k] = 'Clock AOD'; return n
